# 0.6.4 — Setup, generate, and CI deploy fixes

28 September 2026. Patch on **0.6.3**.

Upgrade if `generate` printed an empty error for a missing detection model, a GitHub production deploy never ran, setup rewrote a README or platform comments, or MCP `deploy_rule` crashed. Regenerate a workflow with `opentide setup ci` so production deploy and the checkout depth match this release.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.6.4
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- `generate` exits `1` with a JSON `message` that names the missing `detection_model` UUID, instead of empty stdout and a bare `Exception` ([#352](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/352)).
- MCP `deploy_rule` returns a structured failure for an unknown platform or a platform with no tenants. `deployment_status` is `deployed: false` when the config has no `external_id` and no tenants ([#345](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/345)).
- `--json setup` quotes the path it would write, so a target of `.` no longer reads as `..` ([#346](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/346)).
- Explorer pages are offered only for GitHub. GitLab and Azure warn and write no Explorer job ([#347](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/347)).
- GitHub production deploy needs `generate`, so a push to the default branch still deploys when staging is skipped. Deploy jobs fetch full history ([#348](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/348)).
- `setup --yes --ci none` scaffolds the repository and writes no pipeline. CI-only flags without a real CI platform are named in warnings ([#349](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/349)).
- Re-running setup keeps an edited README, `.gitignore`, and comments in an existing platform toml ([#350](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/350)).
- `lint --fix` reports metadata on the path it just renamed ([#353](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/353)).
- Usage and CLI pages no longer tell the reader to run a command that exits `2` ([#354](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/354)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
```

Expect `0.6.4`.
